kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنحدر (form VII)
# أَنْحَدِرُ (ʔanḥadiru) /ʔan.ħa.di.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# أَنْحَدِرَ (ʔanḥadira) /ʔan.ħa.di.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# أَنْحَدِرْ (ʔanḥadir) /ʔan.ħa.dir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
